rules.disease: urinary tract infection (UTI) with complicated pyelonephritis
rules.sentence: Our initial diagnosis was urinary tract infection (UTI) with complicated pyelonephritis.
Based on the chronic diarrhea and high inflammatory response, inflammatory bowel disease was considered, and colonoscopy was performed.
Biopsy results were consistent with a diagnosis of Crohn’s disease (CD).
Reexamination of CT images from the previous hospital identified air in the bladder, which was also compatible with a vesicointestinal fistula due to CD (Figure 1).
A contrast enema at our institution identified a vesicointestinal fistula (Figure 2).
